description: This file defines the CategoryWorker class in Java, serving as a utility or worker class for handling category-related operations within an e-commerce or product management system. It includes methods for category retrieval, hierarchy management, trail management, and product association checks.

classes.name: CategoryWorker
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for category hierarchy management, trail management, and product-category relationships within an e-commerce system.

methods.name: getCatalogTopCategory
methods.description: Determines the top category for the catalog based on request parameters, session attributes, or default properties, and updates the session accordingly.

methods.name: getCategoriesWithNoParent
methods.description: Retrieves all categories that do not have a parent category and sets them as a request attribute.

methods.name: getRelatedCategories
methods.description: Fetches categories related to a given catalog or category ID, optionally limiting the view and excluding empty categories.

methods.name: getRelatedCategoriesRet
methods.description: Returns a list of related categories for a given parent category ID, with options for limiting and excluding empty categories, supporting recursion.

methods.name: isCategoryEmpty
methods.description: Checks whether a category is empty (no members and no subcategories).

methods.name: categoryMemberCount
methods.description: Counts the number of members within a category.

methods.name: categoryRollupCount
methods.description: Counts the number of categories rolled up under a parent category.

methods.name: setTrail
methods.description: Sets or updates the breadcrumb trail for category navigation in the session.

methods.name: adjustTrail
methods.description: Adjusts an existing breadcrumb trail based on current and previous categories.

methods.name: getTrail
methods.description: Retrieves the current breadcrumb trail from session.

methods.name: setTrail
methods.description: Stores the breadcrumb trail in session.

methods.name: checkTrailItem
methods.description: Checks whether a specific category exists in the breadcrumb trail.

methods.name: lastTrailItem
methods.description: Retrieves the last category in the breadcrumb trail.

methods.name: isProductInCategory
methods.description: Verifies if a product ID belongs to a specific category, including variant products.

methods.name: filterProductsInCategory
methods.description: Filters a list of product objects to include only those belonging to a specified category.

methods.name: getCategoryContentWrappers
methods.description: Constructs content wrappers for categories and their subcategories recursively.

methods.name: getCategoryTrail
methods.description: Generates a full trail of categories from the root to the specified category, useful for exporting or indexing.
